344: 			sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(0), sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(1),

347: 	}
348: #if CONFIG_RX_OPTIMIZE

351: 		LOGE("OpenVela VDDD invalid: 0x%x\r\n",
352: 			sys_hal_vddd_h_vol_get());
353: 		return BK_FAIL;
354: 	}
355: #endif
356: #endif
357: 	return BK_OK;

360: static void pm_openvela_boot_rollback(void)
361: {
362: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
363: 	bk_err_t ret;
364: 
365: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage >= 2)
366: 	{
367: 		ret = bk_cpu2_hold_reset();
368: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
369: 		{
370: 			LOGE("rollback: CPU2 reset hold failed: %d\r\n", ret);
371: 			return;
372: 		}
373: 	}
374: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage >= 3)
375: 	{
376: 		ret = bk_cpu1_hold_reset();
377: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
378: 		{
379: 			LOGE("rollback: CPU1 reset hold failed: %d\r\n", ret);
380: 			return;
381: 		}
382: 	}
383: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage >= 2)
384: 	{
385: 		ret = bk_pm_openvela_cpu2_power_hold(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
386: 		if (ret != BK_OK ||
387: 			sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2) !=
388: 			PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
389: 		{
390: 			LOGE("rollback: CPU2 power off failed: %d state=%d\r\n",
391: 				ret, sys_drv_module_power_state_get(
392: 					PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2));
393: 			return;
394: 		}
395: 	}
396: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage >= 3)
397: 	{
398: 		ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
399: 			PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
400: 		if (ret != BK_OK ||
401: 			sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) !=
402: 			PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
403: 		{
404: 			LOGE("rollback: CPU1 power off failed: %d state=%d\r\n",
405: 				ret, sys_drv_module_power_state_get(
406: 					PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1));
407: 			return;
408: 		}
409: 	}
410: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage >= 1)
411: 	{
412: 		ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1,
413: 			PM_CPU_FRQ_DEFAULT);
414: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
415: 		{
416: 			LOGE("rollback: frequency release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
417: 			return;
418: 		}
419: 	}
420: 	s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 0;
421: #else
422: 	(void)bk_cpu1_hold_reset();
423: 	(void)bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
424: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
425: #endif
426: }

428: static bk_err_t pm_module_bootup_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
429: {
430: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
431: 	uint64_t current_tick   = 0;
432: 	bk_err_t ret;
433: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
434: 	if (module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1 &&
435: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF != sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
436: 	{
437: 		LOGE("CPU1 powered before OpenVela lifecycle transaction\r\n");
438: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
439: 	}
440: #endif
441: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
442: 	{
443: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
444: 		{
445: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
446: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1, PM_CPU_FRQ_480M);
447: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
448: 				return ret;
449: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 1;
450: 			ret = pm_openvela_clock_validate();
451: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
452: 				goto rollback;
453: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
454: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
455: 				goto rollback;
456: 			if (!bk_cpu2_reset_is_held())
457: 			{
458: 				LOGE("CPU2 is not reset-held ctrl=0x%x run=0x%x\r\n",
459: 					bk_cpu2_ctrl_get(), bk_cpu_run_status_get());
460: 				ret = BK_ERR_STATE;
461: 				goto rollback;
462: 			}
463: 			ret = bk_pm_openvela_cpu2_power_hold(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
464: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
465: 				goto rollback;
466: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 2;
467: #else
468: #if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
469: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
470: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
471: 				return ret;
472: #endif
473: #endif
474: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
475: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
476: 			if (ret != BK_OK ||
477: 				sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) !=
478: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
479: 			{
480: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
481: 				if (sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) ==
482: 					PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
483: 					s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 3;
484: #endif
485: 				ret = ret == BK_OK ? BK_FAIL : ret;
486: 				goto rollback;
487: 			}
488: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
489: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 3;
490: #endif
491: 
492: 			#if defined(RECV_LOG_FROM_MBOX)
493: 			void reset_forward_log_status(void);
494: 			// reset cpu1's log transfer status on cpu0.
495: 			reset_forward_log_status();
496: 			#endif
497: 
498: 			ret = bk_cpu1_start_partition();
499: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
500: 				goto rollback;
501: 			mb_ipc_reset_notify(1, 1);
502: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
503: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 4;
504: #endif
505: 
506: 			previous_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
507: 			current_tick = previous_tick;
508: 			while((current_tick - previous_tick) < (PM_BOOT_CP1_WAITING_TIEM*AON_RTC_MS_TICK_CNT))
509: 			{
510: 				if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get()) // wait the cp1 response
511: 				{
512: 					break;
513: 				}
514: 				current_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
515: 			}
516: 
517: 			if(!bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
518: 			{
519: 				LOGE("CPU1 boot timeout stage=%d\r\n",
520: 					s_pm_openvela_boot_stage);
521: 				ret = BK_ERR_TIMEOUT;
522: 				goto rollback;
523: 			}
524: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
525: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 5;
526: 			(void)bk_pm_openvela_diag_dump();
527: #endif
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	return BK_OK;
531: 
532: rollback:
533: 	pm_openvela_boot_rollback();
534: 	(void)bk_pm_openvela_diag_dump();
535: 	return ret;
536: }

545: static bk_err_t pm_module_shutdown_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
546: {
547: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
548: 	GLOBAL_INT_DECLARATION();
549: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
550: 	{
551: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
552: 		{
553: 			#if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
554: 			ret = bk_cpu2_hold_reset();
555: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
556: 			{
557: 				LOGE("shutdown: CPU2 reset hold failed: %d\r\n", ret);
558: 				return ret;
559: 			}
560: 			ret = bk_pm_openvela_cpu2_power_hold(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
561: 			if (ret != BK_OK ||
562: 				sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2) !=
563: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
564: 			{
565: 				LOGE("shutdown: CPU2 power off failed: %d state=%d\r\n",
566: 					ret, sys_drv_module_power_state_get(
567: 						PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2));
568: 				return ret == BK_OK ? BK_FAIL : ret;
569: 			}
570: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(
571: 				PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_OPENVELA,
572: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
573: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
574: 			{
575: 				LOGE("shutdown: OpenVela PSRAM release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
576: 				return ret;
577: 			}
578: 			#endif
579: 			stop_cpu1_core();
580: 			#if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
581: 			bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
582: 			#endif
583: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
584: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
585: 			if (ret != BK_OK ||
586: 				sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) !=
587: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
588: 			{
589: 				LOGE("shutdown: CPU1 power off failed: %d state=%d\r\n",
590: 					ret, sys_drv_module_power_state_get(
591: 						PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1));
592: 				return ret == BK_OK ? BK_FAIL : ret;
593: 			}
594: 			#if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
595: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1,
596: 				PM_CPU_FRQ_DEFAULT);
597: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
598: 			{
599: 				LOGE("shutdown: CPU1 frequency release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
600: 				return ret;
601: 			}
602: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 0;
603: 			#endif
604: 
605: 			GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
606: 			s_pm_cp1_boot_ready = 0;
607: 			ap_console_bridge_link_down();
608: 			s_pm_cp1_closing = 0;
609: 			s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count = 0;
610: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
611: 			ret = rtos_set_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema);
612: 			if(s_pm_cp1_sema_count == 0)
613: 			{
614: 				rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema);
615: 			}
616: 			#if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
617: 			extern void stop_cpu2_core(void);
618: 			stop_cpu2_core();
619: 			bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
620: 
621: 			bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 1, 0);
622: 			#endif
623: 			bk_printf_nonblock(4,NULL,"Shutdown_cp1[%d][%d][%d]\r\n",s_pm_cp1_closing,ret,s_pm_cp1_sema_count); //4:BK_LOG_DEBUG
624: 		}
625: 	}
626: 	return ret;
627: }

629: bk_err_t bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(pm_boot_cp1_module_name_e module,pm_power_module_state_e power_state)
630: {
631: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
632: 	GLOBAL_INT_DECLARATION();
633: 
634: 	BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 %d %d 0x%x [%d][0x%x]E_1\r\n",module, power_state,s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state,s_pm_cp1_closing,&s_sync_cp1_open_sema);
635: 	if (NULL == s_sync_cp1_open_sema)
636: 	{
637: 		rtos_init_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema, 1);
638: 	}
639: 	if(s_pm_cp1_closing)
640: 	{
641: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
642: 		s_pm_cp1_sema_count++;
643: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
644: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 get sema[%d][0x%x]\r\n",s_pm_cp1_sema_count,&s_sync_cp1_open_sema);
645: 
646: 		/*add protect:init again when the s_sync_cp1_open_sema free*/
647: 		if (NULL == s_sync_cp1_open_sema)
648: 		{
649: 			rtos_init_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema, 1);
650: 		}
651: 		ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema, PM_OPEN_CP1_TIMEOUT);
652: 
653: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
654: 		s_pm_cp1_sema_count--;
655: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
656: 		if(ret == kTimeoutErr)
657: 		{
658: 			BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1[%d]0x%llx %d %d %d\r\n",ret,s_pm_cp1_module_recovery_state,bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get(),bk_pm_cp1_recovery_all_state_get(),s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state);
659: 			if(bk_pm_cp1_recovery_all_state_get())
660: 			{
661: 				bk_pm_module_check_cp1_shutdown();
662: 			}
663: 			return ret;
664: 		}
665: 	}
666: 	BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 %d %d 0x%x [%d]E_2\r\n",module, power_state,s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state,ret);
667:     if(power_state == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)//power on
668:     {
669: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
670: 		s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state |= 0x1 << (module);
671: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
672: 		ret = pm_module_bootup_cpu1(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1);
673: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
674: 		{
675: 			GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
676: 			s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state &= ~(0x1 << module);
677: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
678: 			return ret;
679: 		}
680:     }
681:     else //power down
682:     {
683: 		if(s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state&(0x1 << (module)))
684: 		{
685: 			GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
686: 			s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state &= ~(0x1 << (module));
687: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
688: 			if(0x0 == s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state)
689: 			{
690: 				s_pm_cp1_closing = 1;
691: 				BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 %d %d close 0x%llx %d\r\n",module, power_state,s_pm_cp1_module_recovery_state,s_pm_cp1_boot_ready);
692: 				pm_cp0_mailbox_send_data(PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD,0,0,0);
693: 				//pm_module_shutdown_cpu1(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1);
694: 			}
695: 		}
696:     }
697: 
698:     return BK_OK;
699: }

159: static bk_err_t low_pwr_core_message_handle(void)
160: {
161:     bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
162:     low_pwr_core_msg_t msg;
163: 
164:     while (1)
165:     {
166:         ret = rtos_pop_from_queue(&s_pm_info->queue, &msg, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
167: 		LOGV("LP event:%d\n", msg.event);
168:         if (kNoErr == ret)
169:         {
170:             switch (msg.event)
171:             {
172:                 case LOW_PWR_CORE_STATE_ENTER_DEEPSLEEP:
173:                 {
174: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_ENTER_DEEP_SLEEP_CMD,BK_OK,0,0);
175: 					bk_pm_sleep_mode_set(msg.param1);
176:                 }
177:                 break;
178: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_CTRL_CP2_STATE:
179: 				{
180: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_CTRL_AP_STATE_CMD, BK_OK,0,0);
181: 					bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(msg.param1,msg.param2);
182: 				}
183: 				break;
184: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_CP2_RECOVERY:
185: 				{
186: 					bk_pm_cp1_recovery_module_state_ctrl(msg.param1,msg.param2);
187: 				}
188: 				break;
189: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_RTC_DEEPSLEEP:
190: 				{
191: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_RTC_DEEPSLEEP_CMD, BK_OK,0,0);
192: 					bk_low_pwr_misc_rtc_enter_deepsleep(msg.param2,NULL);
193:                 }
194: 				break;
195: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_GET_CP_DATA:
196: 				{
197: 					uint32_t cp_pm_data = 0;
198: 					pm_ap_get_cp_data_type_e data_type = msg.param1;
199: 					pm_openvela_diag_t diag;
200: 
201: 					bk_pm_openvela_diag_get(&diag);
202: 					switch(data_type)
203: 					{
204: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_TIME_INTERVAL_FROM_STARTUP:
205: 							bk_low_pwr_misc_get_time_interval_from_startup(&cp_pm_data);
206: 						break;
207: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_DEEP_SLEEP_WAKEUP_SOURCE:
208: 							cp_pm_data = bk_pm_deep_sleep_wakeup_source_get();
209: 						break;
210: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_EXIT_LOW_VOL_WAKEUP_SOURCE:
211: 							cp_pm_data =  bk_pm_exit_low_vol_wakeup_source_get();
212: 						break;
213: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_CURRENT_FREQUENCY:
214: 							cp_pm_data = (diag.cpu1_vote & 0xff) |
215: 								((diag.max_vote & 0xff) << 8);
216: 						break;
217: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_CLOCK_DIVIDER:
218: 							cp_pm_data = diag.clk_div_reg0;
219: 						break;
220: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_CPU_SPEED:
221: 							cp_pm_data = (diag.cpu_speed[0] & 0xff) |
222: 								((diag.cpu_speed[1] & 0xff) << 8) |
223: 								((diag.cpu_speed[2] & 0xff) << 16);
224: 						break;
225: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_VOLTAGE:
226: 							cp_pm_data = (diag.vddd & 0xffff) |
227: 								((diag.vdddig & 0xffff) << 16);
228: 						break;
229: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_CPU_POWER_RESET:
230: 							cp_pm_data = (diag.cpu1_power & 0xf) |
231: 								((diag.cpu2_power & 0xf) << 4) |
232: 								((diag.cpu_run_status & 0xffff) << 8);
233: 						break;
234: 						case PM_CP_DATE_TYPE_PSRAM_OWNERS:
235: 							cp_pm_data = diag.psram_owners;
236: 						break;
237: 						default:
238: 						break;
239: 					}
240: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD,data_type,cp_pm_data,0);
241: 				}
242: 				break;
243: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_PSRAM_POWER:
244: 				{
245: 					if (msg.param3 != PM_PSRAM_PROTO_V1 ||
246: 						msg.param1 != PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_OPENVELA)
247: 						ret = BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
248: 					else
249: 						ret = bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(msg.param1,msg.param2);
250: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
251: 						msg.param2, ret, msg.param3);
252: 				}
253: 				break;
254: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_POWER_CTRL:
255: 				{
256: 					ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(msg.param1,msg.param2);
257: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_POWER_CTRL_CMD,ret,0,0);
258: 				}
259: 				break;
260: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_CLK_CTRL:
261: 				{
262: 					ret = bk_pm_clock_ctrl(msg.param1,msg.param2);
263: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_CLK_CTRL_CMD, ret,0,0);
264: 				}
265: 				break;
266: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_SLEEP_CTRL:
267: 				{
268: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_SLEEP_CTRL_CMD,BK_OK,0,0);
269: 					ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(msg.param1,msg.param2,msg.param3);
270: 				}
271: 				break;
272: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_FREQ_CTRL:
273: 				{
274: 					ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(msg.param1,msg.param2);
275: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD, ret,0,0);
276: 				}
277: 				break;
278: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_EXTERNAL_LDO:
279: 				{
280: 					ret = bk_pm_module_vote_ctrl_external_ldo(msg.param1,msg.param2,msg.param3);
281: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_CTRL_EXTERNAL_LDO_CMD, ret,0,0);
282: 				}
283: 				break;
284: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_WAKEUP_SRC_CFG:
285: 				{
286: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_WAKEUP_CONFIG_CMD, ret,0,0);
287: 					low_pwr_core_wakeup_src_cfg_handle(&msg);
288: 				}
289: 				break;
290: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_RTC_WAKEUPED:
291: 				{
292: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_SLEEP_WAKEUP_NOTIFY_CMD,PM_MODE_LOW_VOLTAGE,PM_WAKEUP_SOURCE_INT_RTC,0);
293: 					LOGD("rtc_cb[%d]\r\n",bk_pm_exit_low_vol_wakeup_source_get());
294: 					if(!bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
295: 					{
296: 						bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP,PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
297: 					}
298: 				}
299: 				break;
300: 				case LOW_PWR_CORE_GPIO_WAKEUPED:
301: 				{
302: 					bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_SLEEP_WAKEUP_NOTIFY_CMD,PM_MODE_LOW_VOLTAGE,PM_WAKEUP_SOURCE_INT_GPIO,msg.param1);
303: 					LOGD("gpio_cb[%d][%d]\r\n",bk_pm_exit_low_vol_wakeup_source_get(),msg.param1);
304: 					if(!bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
305: 					{
306: 						bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP,PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
307: 					}
308: 				}
309: 				break;
310:                 default:
311:                     break;
312:             }
313:         }
314:     }
315: 
316: 	return  ret;
317: }

319: bk_err_t bk_low_pwr_core_init(void)
320: {
321:     bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
322: 
323:     if (s_pm_info == NULL)
324:     {
325:         s_pm_info = os_malloc(sizeof(low_pwr_core_info_t));
326: 
327:         if (s_pm_info == NULL)
328:         {
329:             LOGE("%s, malloc pm_info failed\n", __func__);
330:             goto error;
331:         }
332: 
333:         os_memset(s_pm_info, 0, sizeof(low_pwr_core_info_t));
334:     }
335: 
336:     if (s_pm_info->queue != NULL)
337:     {
338:         ret = BK_FAIL;
339:         LOGE("%s, pm_info->queue allready init, exit!\n", __func__);
340:         goto error;
341:     }
342: 
343:     if (s_pm_info->thd != NULL)
344:     {
345:         ret = BK_FAIL;
346:         LOGE("%s, pm_info->thd allready init, exit!\n", __func__);
347:         goto error;
348:     }
349: 
350:     ret = rtos_init_queue(&s_pm_info->queue,
351:                           "pm_info->queue",
352:                           sizeof(low_pwr_core_msg_t),
353:                           LOW_PWR_CORE_QUEUE_NUMBER_OF_MESSAGE);
354: 
355:     if (ret != BK_OK)

359:     }

361:     ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_pm_info->thd,
362:                              BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY - 3,/*pm contrl cmd thread priority need higher*/
363:                              "pm_info->thd",
364:                              (beken_thread_function_t)low_pwr_core_message_handle,
365:                              LOW_PWR_CORE_STACK_SIZE,
366:                              NULL);
367:     if (ret != BK_OK)
368:     {
369:         LOGE("create thread fail\n");
370:         goto error;
371:     }
372: 
373:     LOGE("%s success\n", __func__);
374: 
375:     return ret;

378: 
379:     LOGE("%s fail\n", __func__);
380: 	if(s_pm_info->queue != NULL)
381: 	{
382: 		rtos_deinit_queue(&s_pm_info->queue);
383: 	}
384: 	if(s_pm_info->thd != NULL)

386: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_pm_info->thd);

37: static int hex2num(char c)
38: {
39: 	if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
40: 		return c - '0';
41: 	if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
42: 		return c - 'a' + 10;
43: 	if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F')
44: 		return c - 'A' + 10;
45: 	return -1;
46: }
47: 
48: 
49: static int hex2byte(const char *hex)
50: {
51: 	int a, b;
52: 	a = hex2num(*hex++);
53: 	if (a < 0)
54: 		return -1;
55: 	b = hex2num(*hex++);
56: 	if (b < 0)
57: 		return -1;
58: 	return (a << 4) | b;
59: }

61: int hexstr2bin_cli(const char *hex, u8 *buf, size_t len)
62: {
63: 	size_t i;
64: 	int a;
65: 	const char *ipos = hex;
66: 	u8 *opos = buf;
67: 
68: 	for (i = 0; i < len; i++) {
69: 		a = hex2byte(ipos);
70: 		if (a < 0)
71: 			return -1;
72: 		*opos++ = a;
73: 		ipos += 2;
74: 	}
75: 	return 0;
76: }

253: static void boot_cpu_core(char *pcWriteBuffer, int xWriteBufferLen, int argc, char **argv)
254: {
255: 	uint32_t core = 0;
256: 	uint32_t mode = 0;
257: 
258: 	if (argc == 3) {
259: 		core = os_strtoul(argv[1], NULL, 10);
260: 		mode = os_strtoul(argv[2], NULL, 10);
261: 		CLI_LOGD("boot_core id(%d), mode(%d).\r\n", core, mode);
262: 		
263: 		if(mode == 1)
264: 		{
265: 			if(core == 1)
266: 			{
267: 				bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP,PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);//for test:using the app vote for boot cp1
268: 			}
269: 			if(core == 2)
270: 			{
271: 				bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
272: 				start_cpu2_core();
273: 			}
274: 		}
275: 		else if(mode == 0)
276: 		{
277: 			if(core == 1)
278: 			{
279: 				bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP,PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);//for test:using the app vote for boot cp1
280: 			}
281: 			if(core == 2)
282: 			{
283: 				stop_cpu2_core();
284: 				bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
285: 			}
286: 		}
287: 		else	//test start/stop many times.
288: 		{
289: 			uint32_t i = 0;
290: 
291: 			//start first:odd will be at start status, even will be at stop status
292: 			while(1)
293: 			{
294: 				if(core == 1)
295: 				{
296: 					bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP,PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);//for test:using the app vote for boot cp1
297: 				}
298: 				if(core == 2)
299: 				{
300: 					bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
301: 					start_cpu2_core();
302: 				}
303: 				i++;
304: 				if(i == mode)
305: 					break;
306: 				if(core == 1)
307: 				{
308: 					bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP,PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);//for test:using the app vote for boot cp1
309: 				}
310: 				if(core == 2)
311: 				{
312: 					stop_cpu2_core();
313: 					bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
314: 				}
315: 				i++;
316: 				if(i == mode)
317: 					break;
318: 			}
319: 			CLI_LOGD("boot on/off %d times.\r\n", mode);
320: 		}
321: 	} else {
322: 		CLI_LOGD("bootcore [core id] [mode: 1:start,2:stop].\r\n");
323: 	}
324: 
325: 
326: 	CLI_LOGD("boot_cpu_core end.\r\n");
327: }
328: #endif

1: # Beken AVDK 覆盖与构建基线
2: 
3: 本目录保存 BK7258 OpenVela 最终固件构建所需的 Beken AVDK 覆盖文件，并作为
4: 多人协作时 `bk_avdk_smp` 修改的同步记录。不要只修改工作区中的
5: `~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`；可复现修改必须同时更新本目录及本文档。
6: 
7: ## 1. 当前覆盖文件
8: 
9: | 比赛仓权威副本 | `bk_avdk_smp` 目标文件 | 作用 |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | 注册 `ap_console` CLI 命令 |
12: | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | UART0 CP_CLI/AP_CONSOLE owner 状态机、延迟切换和退出转义 |
13: | `cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c` | `cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c` | DVFS 错误传播、vote/cache rollback 和 CPU/PSRAM 联合 VDDDIG 下限 |
14: | `cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c` | CPU1/CPU2 语义化 reset helper、run-status readback |
15: | `cp/components/controller_if/cif_ipc.c` | `cp/components/controller_if/cif_ipc.c` | 保留 Wi-Fi IPC RX status callback ABI |
16: | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | CP UART0 bridge 模式、写入和统计接口 |
17: | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | shell 与 bridge 的切换/链路事件接口 |
18: | `cp/include/components/system.h` | `cp/include/components/system.h` | CPU reset/readback 语义化接口 |
19: | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | transport event、诊断和 poll 接口 |
20: | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | MB_UART link event、状态和 poll 接口 |
21: | `cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h` | `cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h` | PSRAM V1、OpenVela lifecycle 与 PM 诊断接口 |
22: | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | MB_UART0 唯一 owner、LOG/RAW RX、1024 B TX ring 和 worker |
23: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | 完整 ACK 匹配、timeout/reset、probe 和诊断 |
24: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c` | IPC power-up ready 门禁事件 |
25: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` | heartbeat/reset/down 自动回退事件 |
26: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | 严格 DATA/STATE 校验、ACK 后推进和 link event |
27: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | command/ACK/reset/sync 分离稳定 slot |

1: # Beken AVDK 覆盖与构建基线
2: 
3: 本目录保存 BK7258 OpenVela 最终固件构建所需的 Beken AVDK 覆盖文件，并作为
4: 多人协作时 `bk_avdk_smp` 修改的同步记录。不要只修改工作区中的
5: `~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`；可复现修改必须同时更新本目录及本文档。
6: 
7: ## 1. 当前覆盖文件
8: 
9: | 比赛仓权威副本 | `bk_avdk_smp` 目标文件 | 作用 |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_misc.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_misc.c` | OpenVela 480 MHz 模式禁用 `bootcore` 对 CPU2 的 legacy start/stop |
12: | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | 注册 `ap_console` CLI 命令 |
13: | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | UART0 CP_CLI/AP_CONSOLE owner 状态机、延迟切换和退出转义 |
14: | `cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c` | `cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c` | DVFS 错误传播、vote/cache rollback 和 CPU/PSRAM 联合 VDDDIG 下限 |
15: | `cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c` | CPU1/CPU2 语义化 reset helper、run-status readback |
16: | `cp/components/controller_if/cif_ipc.c` | `cp/components/controller_if/cif_ipc.c` | 保留 Wi-Fi IPC RX status callback ABI |
17: | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | CP UART0 bridge 模式、写入和统计接口 |
18: | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | shell 与 bridge 的切换/链路事件接口 |
19: | `cp/include/components/system.h` | `cp/include/components/system.h` | CPU reset/readback 语义化接口 |
20: | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | transport event、诊断和 poll 接口 |
21: | `cp/include/driver/low_pwr_core.h` | `cp/include/driver/low_pwr_core.h` | OpenVela 最终 ready worker 事件 |
22: | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | MB_UART link event、状态和 poll 接口 |

147: ## 3. 正确构建链条
148: 
149: 最终固件链条固定为：
150: 
151: ```text
152: OpenVela nuttx.bin
153:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
154:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
155:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
156:   -> package/all-app.bin
157: 
158: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
159:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
160: ```
161: 
162: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
163: 
164: - `ram_regions.csv`
165: - AP/CP `config`
166: - Kconfig 默认值
167: - 分区生成脚本
168: - SoC 链接脚本
169: 
170: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
171: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
172: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
173: 
174: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 SMP 工作树：
175: 
176: ```bash
177: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
178: ./build.sh \
179:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
180:   -e -Werror --cmake -j8
181: 
182: cp \
183:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
184:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
185: ```
186: 
187: 然后执行项目级 clean 和容器内完整构建：
188: 
189: ```bash
190: cd ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
191: make -C projects/app_ab clean
192: 
193: podman run --rm \
194:   --userns=keep-id \
195:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
196:   -w /armino \
197:   -e EXTRA_CFLAGS=-Werror \
198:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
199:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
200:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
201:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
202: ```
203: 
204: `make -C projects/app_ab clean`只删除`projects/app_ab/build`，不会删除
205: `build/openvela-ap.bin`。仅安装 Podman 时不要使用内部调用 Docker 的`dbuild.sh`。
206:

212: grep -q '^#define CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4 1$' "$generated"
213: grep -q '^#define CONFIG_GPIO_DEFAULT_SET_SUPPORT 1$' "$generated"

215: mirror=../contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp

**实际修改**
- 新增 `PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD=0x11` 和 `LOW_PWR_CORE_OPENVELA_READY`：
  - `0x5` 只解除 CP boot 等待并推进到 stage 5，不再发布 PWC/bridge ready。
  - `0x11 param1=1` 由 low-power worker 检查 stage 5、480 MHz clock、CPU1/CPU2 power、CPU2 hold 和 OpenVela PSRAM owner；全部通过后进入 stage 6 并发布 PWC ready。
  - `0x11 param1=0` 使用 `param2` 的真实负 errno 执行完整 best-effort rollback。

  - 不再因单项失败提前返回。
